# Grafana Labs

> > Grafana is the open and composable observability platform for metrics, logs, and traces, offering Grafana Cloud, Loki, Prometheus integration, and incident management tools.

Grafana Labs provides open-source and commercial observability solutions including Grafana dashboards, Loki log aggregation, OnCall incident management, and cloud-native monitoring for Kubernetes and Prometheus. The platform serves developers and operations teams building monitoring and alerting systems.

## Key Topics

- Grafana Cloud
- Observability
- Prometheus
- Grafana Loki
- Kubernetes
- Metrics and monitoring
- Logs and traces
- Incident Response Management
- OnCall
- Synthetic testing
- Free tier cloud platform
- Community forums (community.grafana.com)
- Grafana Labs
- Cloud-native monitoring
- Open-source visualization
